sentences.text:
Amlendu Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 5 February,
2026
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.12851 of 2024
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-219 Year-2022 Thana- Mansi District-

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
======================================================
 Amlendu Kumar Singh, S/o Late Chandrika Singh Resident of Village-
 Hajipur Samata Colony, P.S.-Town Hajipur, District-Vaishali at Hajipur.

2. Laxmi Devi, W/o Late Amarjeet Chaudhary R/o Village-Khutia, P.S.-Mansi,
 District-Khagaria.

Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Vindhya Keshri Kumar, Sr. Advocat
 Mr. Nawal Singh, Advocate

For the Opposite Party/s : Ms. Pushpa Sinha, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sourendra Pandey
 Oral Order
3 05-02-2026
Heard Mr. Vindhya Keshri Kumar, learned Senior counsel assisted by Mr. Nawal Singh, learned counsel, for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The present application has been filed by the petitioner invoking the inherent jurisdiction of this Hon'ble Court for quashing the FIR bearing Mansi P.S. Case No. 219 of 2022 registered for the offences under Sections 420, 166A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 74 of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 of Amended Act, 2018.

entities.text: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 of Amended Act, 2018
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned Senior counsel for the petitioner submits that from the perusal of the FIR, it would be evident that it is not a case of offences under the provision of the Prevention of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.12851 of 2024(3) dt.05-02-2026 Corruption Act, as no case is made out with the allegations as levelled in the FIR.

It has further been submitted that apart from vague allegations of offering help to informant in the case filed against her and allegations of calling on the phone with ill intention, there is nothing on record to suggest anything against the petitioner.
It has next been submitted that the petitioner has been targeted at the behest of his colleagues and a false and concocted case has been lodged through the present informant.

4. In view of the aforesaid submissions, let notice be issued to the opposite party no. 2 through Amlendu Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171022366/
1 registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process with present and correct address for which requisite etc. must be filed within one week.
5. Put up this case on 23.03.2026 after appearance of the opposite party no. 2 or on receipt of service of notice, whichever is earlier, at 02:15 P.M.
6.

sentences.text: In the meantime, till the next date of hearing, further proceedings in the concerned Court below with respect to the petitioner, in connection with the present case shall remain stayed.

(Sourendra Pandey, J) manoj/-
